info.title: ScopeLock API
info.description: System of record for client scope, change requests, approvals and delivery evidence. This document covers the integration surface (API keys, outgoing webhooks, external integrations). Shapes are generated from the Zod contracts in packages/contracts; regenerate with `npm run openapi`.

get.description: Lexical ranking over decided approvals (semantic pgvector ranking only when Postgres and an embeddings provider are configured, with silent lexical fallback). Results are filtered by the requester's project access before ranking and carry verbatim excerpts plus links — no generated conclusions.

200.description: Ranked past decisions with the effective mode.

post.description: Delivered through the outbox with exponential backoff. Verify `X-ScopeLock-Signature` (`v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<timestamp>.<raw body>")>`) with a constant-time compare and reject timestamps older than 5 minutes.
